terms.comment: Greek πεντηκοστή, the fiftieth day after Easter. In the Orthodox Church it is also the feast of the Holy Trinity, and the Monday after is the day of the Holy Spirit; in the West Trinity Sunday is the Sunday after Pentecost. diēs Pentēcostēs, the day of Pentecost (Morgan–Owens).

phrases.latin: Et cum complērentur diēs Pentēcostēs, erant omnēs pariter in eōdem locō
phrases.english: When the day of Pentecost had come, they were all together in one place

phrases.latin: et quōmodo nōs audīvimus ūnusquisque linguam nostram in quā nātī sumus?
phrases.english: and how is it that each of us hears them in the language he was born to?

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. Christian: Pentecost.
